Warn.NoGM: No GM online – thrown weapons can't be left behind right now.
Warn.TooFar: Too far away – you must be within {range} ft.
Warn.NoPermission: You don't have permission to do that.

Chat.StillStuck: {item} is stuck fast and stays in.

improvisedThrow.Name: All melee weapons can be thrown
improvisedThrow.Hint: Weapons without the Thrown property get a "Thrown (improvised)" mode in the attack dialog. Requires reload.

autoDetectRange.Name: Detect throws by distance
autoDetectRange.Hint: A melee attack against a target out of reach counts as a throw.

excludeNames.Name: Excluded names
excludeNames.Hint: Comma separated. Weapons whose name contains one of these never stay behind (ammunition is always ignored).

stickOnHit.Name: Hits get stuck
stickOnHit.Hint: On a hit the weapon moves into the target's inventory and is shown stuck in its token. Off: hits land on the ground too.

missRadius.Name: Miss scatter (ft)
missRadius.Hint: How far from the target a missed weapon may land.

fumbleMin.Name: Fumble: minimum distance (ft)
fumbleMin.Hint: On a natural 1 the weapon lands at least this far from the target.

fumbleMax.Name: Fumble: maximum distance (ft)
fumbleMax.Hint: On a natural 1 the weapon lands at most this far from the target.

groundSize.Name: Size on the ground
groundSize.Hint: Size of a weapon lying on the ground, in grid squares.

stuckIconSize.Name: Size of stuck weapons
stuckIconSize.Hint: Size of the weapon icon on a hit token, in grid squares.

pickupRange.Name: Pick up: range (ft)
pickupRange.Hint: How close a player's token must be to pick a weapon up by double-click.

pullRange.Name: Pull out: range (ft)
pullRange.Hint: How close a player's token must be to the target to pull out a stuck weapon.

pullAutoDamage.Name: Pull out: apply damage automatically
pullAutoDamage.Hint: On: if the pull-out attack hits, damage is subtracted from the target right away. Off: damage only appears as a damage chat card and the GM applies it from there (or not).

pullStaysOnMiss.Name: Pull out: stays stuck on a miss
pullStaysOnMiss.Hint: If the pull-out attack misses, the weapon stays stuck. Off: it still comes out, just without damage.

iconAngle.Name: Weapon image orientation (°)
iconAngle.Hint: Which way the point faces in weapon images. 45 = up and to the right (usual for dnd5e icons).

defaultStyle.Name: Default flight style
defaultStyle.Hint: For weapons not in any keyword list.

straightKeywords.Name: Keywords: straight flight
straightKeywords.Hint: Comma separated. These fly point first (spears etc.).

spinKeywords.Name: Keywords: spinning
spinKeywords.Hint: Comma separated. These spin in flight (axes, hammers …).

fastSpinKeywords.Name: Keywords: fast spinning
fastSpinKeywords.Hint: Comma separated. These spin quickly (daggers, knives …).

chatMessages.Name: Chat messages
chatMessages.Hint: Short chat notes when a weapon sticks, fumbles, is picked up or pulled out.

Dialog.Content: Something is stuck in {target}. What do you want to do?
Dialog.OtherHint: Double-click the token again now for the normal action.
